newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - EVENING STANDARD - APRIL 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - EVENING STANDARD - APRIL 22.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company
HEAD-ON CRASH KILLS MOTHER AND CHILDREN

Following a crash yesterday on the B526 Newport Pagnell to Stoke Goldington in which a mother and her two young children were killed when her car veered across the road headlong into a good vehicle travelling in the opposite direction, investigators were trying to determine how the incident occurred.

The Halifax made an announcement to its investors today to return their necessary forms by May 26 in order to receive cash or shares. Customers will not be credited unless written instructions are received.
SCOTTISH POWER AIMS FOR NEW YORK LISTING
Scottish Power is the first north of the border company to consider a listing on the New York stock exchange. Currently the multi-utilities group is 8 percent held in the US in the form of ADRs.
D-MARK IN REVERSE ON FRENCH POLLS FACTOR

As dealers took a wait-and-see approach on whether French elections could effect the process towards monetary union, the deutschmark reversed some of yesterday steep gains in overnight markets. The Deutschmark lost ground against the French franc, up a fraction at 3.375 after falling almost a centime yesterday.
EXPORTERS CALL UP NAVAL SALES POWER

The Royal Navy is to come to the aid of the British financial services industry by promoting it abroad. HMS Invincible is set to visit Barcelona later this month. British Invisibles launches its first coordinated effort involving embassies overseas, the Department of Trade and Industry and the Corporation of London.
